events.event_name: NEST New York Cardamom Latte Café
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW fragrance-launch café for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, pairing fragrance discovery with a complimentary cardamom latte.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary cardamom lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Complimentary lattes and sampling are while supplies last. Current sources conflict on the closing time: NYC for FREE, Off The MRKT and Pulsd list 9 PM, while Average Socialite lists 5 PM; the 10 AM start is consistent across current sources.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 at Chelsea Triangle. Current majority-source hours are 10 AM–9 PM; arrive earlier because promotional inventory can run out.

events.event_name: Fashion Designers of Latin America: The Life of Giannina Azar
events.address: United Palace, 4140 Broadway, New York, NY 10033
events.what_it_is: A free immersive runway showcase by Giannina Azar with models moving through the audience and a live performance by Maria Del Sol.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary general-admission entry was offered by RSVP.
events.caveats: United Palace's official ticket page currently marks both free general-admission sections sold out. Do not treat older secondary listings saying 'RSVP' as current availability.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14. Doors 6 PM; show 7 PM. Official free RSVP inventory is sold out as of this verification.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded NYFW truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Dewy Lip Shine sampling and branded sweet treats are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current event listings consistently describe this as open to the public. Samples and treats are while supplies last; no RSVP or host-approval requirement is established in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public Mary Kay beauty activation built around its Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product giveaways, touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: The organizer advertises 10,000 free makeup and skincare products, plus the public beauty experience; giveaway inventory is finite.
events.caveats: Mary Kay U.S. is the organizer on the Eventbrite page. Current sources describe the event as free and open to the public; Eventbrite registration is available, but no organizer-selection or approval step is established. Giveaways remain inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Use the Mary Kay organizer Eventbrite page to register in advance.

events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day in-store public Fashion Week runway where visitors can walk, be filmed for Century 21 social stories and customize a tote.
events.what_is_free: Every participating walker is offered a free Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while tote/patch supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21 explicitly says there is no registration, ticket or invitation. Participants are filmed for Century 21's Instagram/TikTok stories. Totes and patches are while supplies last; the discount card requires a $100 in-store purchase to redeem.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 and Wednesday, September 16 from 12–6 PM on the main floor, Dey Street side. No sign-up required.

events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A public Hempz Serene Waters with Magnesium activation outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square with product discovery and a relaxation-themed street pop-up.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free magnesium iced teas from Drink Wild and additional Hempz surprises while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current public listings agree on September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM and describe the activation as open to the public. Promotional drinks/surprises are inventory-dependent. No RSVP or approval requirement is established.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square.
